name: Hexyl laurate
description: Hexyl laurate (CAS 34316-64-8 ), also known as hexyl dodecanoate, is a synthetic ester used as an emollient, solvent, and carrier in personal care and pharmaceutical formulations. It provides a light, non-greasy skin feel while improving the spreadability and texture of finished products. In cosmetic formulations, this ester functions as an emollient and texture modifier in skin creams, lotions, and color cosmetics. It effectively reduces the heavy or tacky feel often associated with heavier oils in complex mixtures. It acts as a solvent and carrier for active ingredients, pigments, and UV filters in sunscreen and foundation formulations where uniform dispersion is critical. This ensures a consistent application and performance across various skin types. Pharmaceutical topical preparations use it as a plasticizer and penetration-enhancing carrier to improve the delivery and skin compatibility of active compounds. Its low viscosity makes it suitable as a dispersing medium in lip care products. The material is also utilized in hair conditioning products to enhance shine and manageability without leaving a heavy residue. Its versatile nature allows it to be integrated into a wide range of high-performance beauty and health care solutions. Hexyl laurate is supplied as a clear, mobile liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial-scale formulation. It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications for diverse manufacturing needs. Purity levels typically meet requirements for use in regulated personal care and topical drug products.
